query: Our required GitHub Actions workflow takes 22 minutes. Logs show 12 minutes waiting for a hosted runner and 10 minutes executing jobs. We could buy a larger runner, remove a security check, or split the integration suite. How should we reduce the wait?
expected_behavior: Separates runner queue wait from job execution time and targets the measured source of end-to-end delay
Compares runner cost and end-to-end throughput before recommending added capacity or workflow changes
Does not remove the required security check to reduce elapsed time
Considers how splitting the integration suite affects test validity, failures, and recovery before recommending it
Keeps the existing workflow boundary and protected release behavior in view
